text:
Nina: Preflight update- packaging checksum mismatch detected between builder and artifact-store. Target change window Fri 01:00-03:00 UTC. Stagger plan: ap-southeast -> eu -> us.
Leo: Copy. Will hold canary in ap-southeast at 3% until checksums reconcile.
DeployBot: Release candidate uploaded: engine:v2.14-quant-beta. Builder sha256=deadbeefcafebabe, store sha256=deadbeefcafebabf (mismatch). CI: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4301
QA_Arun: Re-running verification harness. Seeing small quantization rounding diffs in int8 sim on a handful of prompts, non-blocking but logging.
Nina: Do not proceed with deployment until we confirm artifact integrity. Leo: hold on any rollout commands.
Leo: Running local verify: `sha256sum engine-v2.14-quant-beta.tar.gz` -> deadbeefcafebabe. Investigating upload step.
Sam: If upload still produces different checksum, fallback plan is to pin to last-signed artifact: engine:v2.13-release (sha256:abcabcabcabc1234) and abort ramp.
SRE_Maya: Preparing emergency pin command in case we need to freeze traffic:
```
deploybot pin add --service=engine --image=engine:v2.13-release --reason="checksum mismatch" --ttl=6h
```
I'll apply if mismatch persists.
DeployBot: Pin prepared (requires SRE confirmation).
Leo: Root cause looks like packaging host adding gzip mtime metadata during compress step. Rebuilding with `--no-name --mtime=0` to make archive deterministic.
QA_Arun: Also rerunning KV cache stress. Early signal: int8 path KV refill +8% (within our 10% threshold). Will report regressions if any.
Nina: Good. Once rebuilt & verified: small eu canary (5% for 20m), then us-east at 10%, then ramp to 100% if green. Rollback triggers: p95 increase >12% sustained 10m OR error rate >0.5% sustained 5m. Rollback procedure: `deploybot rollback --to=engine:v2.13-release` then drain nodes.
PM_Eli: Note for release notes: call out deterministic packaging fix and mention potential micro-diffs for tokenization on long system messages.
DeployBot: New artifact uploaded: engine:v2.14-quant-beta (sha256=deadbeefcafebabe). Store verified to match.
SRE_Maya: Applying unpin and clearing hold.
DeployBot: Pin removed by SRE_Maya at 01:45 UTC. Canary scheduled to start.
DeployBot: Canary started ap-southeast-1 @01:48 UTC, 3%.
DeployBot: Canary metrics (15m): p95 +2%, errors 0.02%, KV refill +9%.
Leo: Metrics look good. Proceeding to eu-west-1 5% per plan.
QA_Arun: Full regression run finished: no new tokenizer regressions beyond previous micro-diffs; behavioral diffs documented in /releases/4301/regression_notes.md.
Sam: Preparing rollback tag & pin in case of late regressions. Recommended drain-timeout = 120s.
Nina: Thanks team. Once we hit 100% and changelog PR merges I'll close thread. Release notes PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/1305
PM_Eli: Added a short note about the deterministic packaging fix in the PR.
DeployBot: Staggered eu ramp started. Next update will be when us-east roll begins or if any alert fires.
SRE_Maya: I'll keep a temp alert on p95 drift and KV churn for the next 3 hours.
Nina: Handoff: Leo owns the ramp, Arun owns regression signoff, Maya owns alerts/escalation. Closing after final merge and 100% confirmation. :rocket:
